items.title: Show HN: Auracommit – Token-efficient AI Git commit generation from Git diff
items.why_it_matters: Auracommit is a new, token-efficient CLI tool that generates clean, interactive Git commits file-by-file from your Git diffs. Since AI-ingest is your first repo where you are practicing real commit discipline, this tool helps you write professional, granular commits without wasting your API budget on massive monolithic diffs. Run `npm install -g auracommit` in your terminal today and use it to generate the commit for your next feature branch.

items.title: Show HN: Hindcast (search, replay, and resume any Claude Code session on Mac)
items.why_it_matters: Hindcast is a new open-source Mac tool that lets you search, replay, and resume any of your past Claude Code sessions. As a vibe coder, learning how to direct AI is all about reviewing what worked and what didn't; this tool lets you audit your past Claude Code prompts so you can get better at directing the model. Clone the Hindcast repo, run it on your Mac, and replay your last building session to see exactly where Claude got stuck.

items.title: Two LLM calls beat one: 67% cheaper and 100% vs. 72% extraction accuracy
items.why_it_matters: A new open-source benchmark shows that splitting data extraction into two smaller LLM calls instead of one large one is 67% cheaper and increases accuracy from 72% to 100%. Your AI-ingest app relies on filtering and extracting relevant news from noisy feeds; optimizing this pipeline will directly lower your Claude API bills while giving you cleaner results. Open your AI-ingest filtering code and refactor your main extraction prompt into two sequential, smaller calls to test if it improves your filtering accuracy.

items.title: Small, self-hosted MCP that gives Claude read/write access to your Google Sheets
items.why_it_matters: A new, lightweight Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you give Claude read/write access to your Google Sheets. Since you use Claude Code daily, you can use this to let Claude automatically log your build progress, track bugs, or manage a simple roadmap directly in a spreadsheet without leaving your terminal. Install this MCP server, link it to a Google Sheet, and ask Claude Code to write a quick summary of your current git status to the sheet.

items.title: Show HN: HeyDeacon, AI customer support agent for SaaS founders
items.why_it_matters: HeyDeacon launched as a drop-in customer support SDK designed specifically for SaaS founders to chat with site visitors and collect feedback. When you ship AI-ingest, you'll need a quick way to hear from users without building a complex feedback system from scratch. Sign up for a free HeyDeacon account and drop their SDK script tag into your Next.js layout file to instantly add user feedback capabilities to your app.
